The plate is about 400 px across, which I take as roughly 26 cm. That gives about 15 px per cm.

The food looks like fried cassava or potato chunks coated in a red sauce. There are about 8 pieces, each roughly 2.5–3 cm across and 1.5 cm thick, so about 8–10 cm³ each. At roughly 0.7 g/cm³ for fried, airy chunks, that is about 6–8 g per piece, or about 55 g for all of them.

The sauce is visible as a thin red coating, so I count it separately at about 10 g.
